page.overview:
Who is Ester Stepashin?

Ester is under five feet tall, with large brown eyes, a short cap of dark brown curls and a small, upturned nose. She is cute, almost doll-like, which she does not like having pointed out, any more than she enjoys anyone referring to her height.

With a strength level is , she is strong for an Aes Sedai. She is strong enough to Travel.

Among the ten ferrets, Ester is the second in hierarchy by strength and years of training.

Ester is 45 years old. She was born in 955 NE and went to the White Tower in 972 NE. After spending seven years as a novice and eight years as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in .
